tactic.name: 等待制造跨轮连续行动窗口
tactic.source_claim_paraphrase: 等待队列按速度反序行动。严格最快的队伍可以本轮最后行动，再于下轮最先行动，形成连续行动窗口。
tactic.goal: Choose timing that improves exchange value while accounting for the opponent's intervening opportunities
key_mechanics: WAIT postpones this stack's turn to the waiting phase
Waiting phase uses reverse speed order
Next round restores normal initiative ordering
preconditions: Chosen stack is strictly faster than every other surviving stack
No morale extra action, speed-changing effect, hidden action or battle termination disrupts this minimal test
The stack survives until the delayed action
operation_order: Build a legal minimal state with one faster and one slower opposing stack
Trace round and active-stack transitions through the slower stack's action
Require faster stack's delayed action followed by its next-round normal action with no opposing action between
Compare full battle or finite-window casualty value to a same-seed legal non-WAIT control
tactic.success_reason: Delaying can create a two-action window across the round boundary, while allowing the opponent to act earlier this round
failure_conditions: Slower stack can inflict decisive damage before delayed action
Enemy shooter gains a free effective shot
A terminal battle never reaches the next round
Waiting produces no strategic benefit despite correct ordering
tactic.offense: Exploit a verified speed advantage to attack late and reposition or attack first next round
tactic.defense: Deny profitable targets or preserve an answer instead of making the desired delayed attack available
tactic.opponent_responses_status: Lab hypotheses for testing; not attributed to an observed Hallas opponent
tactic.scope: v15 battle candidate; no active hero magic required
source_unknowns: Actual historical creature types and counts
tactic.reconstruction_disclosure: Lab-generated armies, positions, seeds and response policies are a new experiment, not a recovered human demonstration
tactic.version_difference_status: Pinned VCMI turn-order behavior must be verified against actual execution; cannot assume equivalence from names

required_evidence: Legal action masks and chosen IDs
Actor and round trace showing actual delayed/next-round order
Same-seed control and randomized independent variants
Expert labeling based on measured advantage, including reject/no-benefit cases
Before/after model and ordinary-battle regression results
integration_gate: Rule replication is distinct from tactic advantage, demonstration quality, BC success and independent generalization; report each separately.
